title: Metal-based triazoles as a medical marvel of the modern era: a comprehensive review
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1457-1498
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07766D, Review Article

Kashif Haseeb, Muhammad Hasnain Mustafa, Wardha Zafar, Abrar Ul Hassan, Zahid Hussain Chohan, Sajjad Hussain Sumrra
This review highlights the therapeutic applications of triazole Schiff base metal complexes, their coordination with metal ions, key biological activities and discusses half-life, toxicity concerns, and strategies to overcome these challenges.
